messages:
alice_cs: Heads-up — VoltMetrics onboarding failing CI with bursty 429s on their matrix builds (7 runners). They report many preflight requests at cold start and a handful of 401s during token rotation.

 tom_eng: Can you paste one of their raw responses?

 alice_cs: Snippet from GH Actions: 
 ```
 HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
 Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 11:02:12 GMT
 Retry-After: 6
 Content-Type: application/json
 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","stage":"preflight_concurrency"}
 ```
 They also show `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` while their ephemeral mint service rolls keys.

 rachel_onboard: Pattern looks like each runner does a fresh ephemeral mint + SDK preflight -> auth + preflight multiplied by 7. If retries ignore Retry-After they amplify the window.

 tom_eng: Short checklist to propose to customer: 1) Use a job-level token issuer or tiny token-broker that writes token to the workspace so other matrix jobs reuse it. 2) Stagger runner startup by 200-1200ms. 3) Respect Retry-After and implement jittered exponential backoff. 4) If immediate concurrency required, ask CS for a temporary dev-burst quota.

 alice_cs: Shared a minimal broker sketch and backoff snippet. Broker (concept): a single step that mints token and does `echo "$TOKEN" > /github/workspace/token.txt` for other jobs to read.

 tom_eng: Backoff pseudo: 
 ```
 for i in 0..4:
   resp = call()
   if resp.status == 429:
     ra = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 2))
     sleep((2**i + random()) * ra)
     continue
   return resp
 ```
 Also recommend issuing new tokens a few seconds before expiry to reduce 401 during rotation.

 victor_pm: Renewal risk: VoltMetrics has an investor demo in 72h. Flagging high — schedule enablement tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need CI green for 3 successive runs.

 alice_cs: VoltMetrics implemented token-broker + 500ms stagger and ran 6 CI cycles: 0 429s, 1 transient 401 that cleared on retry. They kept retry logic and TTL overlap tweaks.

 tom_eng: For the transient 401s, ensure minting service pre-warms a new token ~10s before expiry and our auth side accepts a small grace window for just-in-time rotation. If they can't pre-warm, leader-election or lockfile works.

 deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-ONBOARD-3667 for VoltMetrics CI preflight 429s. Priority: high.

 rachel_onboard: I'll add a short onboarding doc section "CI token-broker pattern" with a GH Actions example and a line about honoring Retry-After.

 alice_cs: Customer reports 12 clean runs overnight. I'll close CS-ONBOARD-3667 after 48h stable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
